column3: MT 12:1–2; the following verses of this psalm are MT +1. NASB sets the title in braces before verse 1; “on the sheminith” is rendered “upon an eight-stringed lyre,” and “Save” as “Help.”
Close to the Hebrew; “with a heart and a heart” is rendered “with a double heart.”
Close to the Hebrew; “we will make strong” is rendered “we will prevail,” and “our lips are with us” as “Our lips are our own.”
Close to the Hebrew; “he pants for it” is rendered “for which he longs.”
NASB supplies “As” before “silver,” and renders “crucible of the earth” as “furnace on the earth.”
